findings.text: the zone test matches only a trailing Z/z or an offset ending in minutes, so a stamp like 2026-09-29T01:02:03+00:00:30 is read as naming no zone and _normalize_stamp returns (None, "unknown") where the base returned ("2026-09-29T01:01:33+00:00", "utc").

the same predicate makes _parse_timestamp hand back a naive datetime 2026-09-29 01:01:33 for that stamp where the base returned an aware one, and the shared input table carries no cell for the shape, so the gate this node is measured by cannot see it.
